name: io.github.drewburchfield/help-scout-mcp
title: Help Scout MCP Server
description: MCP server for Help Scout with full read coverage and opt-in write support: conversations, customers, organizations, reports, metadata, and Docs through a compact gateway tool surface.

environmentVariables.name: HELPSCOUT_APP_ID
environmentVariables.description: Help Scout OAuth2 App ID (also accepts HELPSCOUT_CLIENT_ID)

environmentVariables.name: HELPSCOUT_APP_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Help Scout OAuth2 App Secret (also accepts HELPSCOUT_CLIENT_SECRET)

environmentVariables.name: HELPSCOUT_DEFAULT_INBOX_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional default inbox ID for scoped searches

environmentVariables.name: HELPSCOUT_DOCS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Help Scout Docs API key for knowledge base tools

environmentVariables.name: REDACT_MESSAGE_CONTENT
environmentVariables.description: Replace message bodies with placeholders in responses (true/false)
